biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the net math is simple — but the flat $100 is only attached if you apply through the specific offer page linked below; apply any other way and the $100 is not part of the deal. The $300 must be spending you already planned.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
The $100 statement credit requires $300 in spending within the first 3 months — spread it over normal purchases, not a splurge.
You must apply through the offer page; the flat offer is not available from other entry points.
Applicants who previously received a new-cardholder bonus for this product within the last 48 months may be ineligible for the bonus.
Discover's fetched text did not state when the $100 statement credit posts after you qualify — do not assume a date.
The card also includes the unlimited first-year Cashback Match, which posts within two billing periods after the first 365 days.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.
